summary: Requirements grill of platform-base across four ledgered Codex cold-read rounds (gpt-5.6-terra @ xhigh), re-run after the spec was reconciled to decisions 0006/0008/0010/0011/0012. Every blocking gap and contradiction was resolved by a spec edit or a decision record. The loop was stopped by explicit human decision after round 4: finding counts ran 4/7/8/6 without converging, and roughly half of each round's findings were contradictions introduced by the previous round's own added precision. Remaining items are refinements, parked below as non-blocking; the task gates still grill each task plan before any code is written.
gaps: The local runtime contract was undefined: no ports, no service startup, no env values, so 'builds and boots' was not reproducible
Mock-OTP login was not reproducible from 'code 000000' alone: it needs AUTH_OTP_MOCK=true, a non-production NODE_ENV, and a seeded provisioned principal
'RBAC + session + audit as-is' had no observable acceptance proof, so an implementation could look logged in while weakening them
The API boundary was unstated: vendored capability routes stayed reachable although the trimmed migration removed their tables
The bound design was a directory, not a named export or revision, and 'unavailable/disabled' controls were undefined
No-account-enumeration was promised in behaviour but absent from the acceptance criteria, so a regression could still pass the story
The warehouse E2E profile could not produce its own stated evidence: warehouse-seed was missing from startup and every WAREHOUSE_PG_* defaults empty
'Harness intact' was unfalsifiable: verify.py runs only the commands FACTORY_* declares and does not guarantee either integrity check is among them
The three-workspace lint/format/typecheck baseline lived only in the plan, not the spec, and root verification treats quality as optional unless declared
The login screen was acceptance-critical and user-facing but had no design authority: the bound export carries no login state
plans/roadmap.json preserved four abbreviated criteria, so a planner working from the roadmap alone would omit the API allow-list, enumeration proof, provenance and loopback/CSRF profile

The vendored backend meets neither the global-exception-handler requirement (constitution 07) nor structured JSON logging with correlationId (constitution 05), and typed response DTO coverage is uneven
contradictions: The spec required a fresh Next.js frontend while the backend CORS origin defaults to http://localhost:5173 (Vite, inherited from Pulse), which rejects every credentialed request from the Next dev server on :3000

'Local' did not mean loopback: main.ts calls app.listen(port) with no host and docker-compose publishes both Postgres ports on all interfaces, so a publicly-known mock code (000000) and a deterministic dev JWT secret expose an admin login to the local network

The API allow-list omitted POST /api/auth/refresh while the spec also required keeping the vendored session stack 'as-is' — silently reducing a 15-minute access / 7-day refresh pairing to re-login every 15 minutes
The spec demanded the real validate -> explain -> execute app path while forbidding any query endpoint, leaving no sanctioned entry point
GET /health was declared fresh code owing full constitution compliance, then specified as unversioned with a raw { status: ok } body against a Swagger standard that states 'Never return raw objects'
The mock-OTP profile mandated literal 127.0.0.1 in some places and localhost in others (FRONTEND_ORIGIN, PGHOST, the frontend API base), which breaks on IPv6 resolution and on Origin comparison
Swagger was described as a non-production exception while swaggerEnabled still honours ENABLE_SWAGGER=true in production, and the allow-list named only the UI route, not its generated document route
resolutions: Spec gained a normative 'Local runtime contract' section: Node 20+, compose up including warehouse-seed, migrations to completion, backend :4000 / frontend :3000, the complete app-DB and WAREHOUSE_PG_* values, and a canonical startup sequence with named readiness signals

The mock-OTP principal is defined: seeded, active, provisioned admin (SEED_USERS-overridable), AUTH_OTP_MOCK=true, non-production NODE_ENV; 'single tenant' means no tenant selector, not arbitrary-email access

Auth guarantees are now observable acceptance criteria: verify creates the session cookies, /api/auth/me resolves principal AND role, logout clears it, and an auth.otp_verified row is appended to audit

The sanctioned PoC allow-list is enumerated and compared by a route-registration test against the complete method/path list: csrf, otp/request, otp/verify, me, logout, refresh, GET /health, plus /api/docs and /api/docs-json non-production only; Swagger must be unconditionally absent when NODE_ENV=production; every other vendored route is unregistered (task api-surface-trim)

The shell is bound to one named export (docs/design/3F-Financial-MIS/3F Financial MIS.dc.html), with the disabled nav, disabled search and unavailable freshness pill recorded as intentional enumerated divergences, and fidelity checked at 1440x900 and 390x844

No-account-enumeration is an explicit acceptance criterion with a required test: active, inactive and unknown emails return identical status and body; unknown and inactive verification fail identically and yield no session

The warehouse profile names WAREHOUSE_DRIVER=postgres, host 127.0.0.1, port 5433, user/database warehouse, password warehouse-local, with the expected result SUM(WarehouseFixture.value) = 42, and requires warehouse-seed to be started and awaited

'Harness intact' is defined as a root-level verify.py run whose FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD explicitly invokes both check_dual_runtime.py and check_vendor_integrity.py, with backend/VENDORED_FROM provenance (repo + commit, decision 0008) asserted separately (task harness-wiring)
The three-workspace ESLint + Prettier + TypeScript baseline is promoted into the spec's acceptance criteria and front-loaded into a new quality-gate-baseline task ahead of the frontend work

The login screen is specified normatively in the spec ('Login screen contract'): split-screen layout from _ds tokens, two-step flow, in-voice uniform-acknowledgement copy, accessibility and motion requirements, and the viewports its visual check uses
The spec's acceptance section carries a normative clause making the full set binding and plans/roadmap.json an abbreviated pointer that never narrows it

Decision 0012 records a time-bounded deviation for the two verified vendored gaps plus uneven DTO coverage, ledgered as deferral D-0004 on decision 0011's revisit trigger; Swagger was verified compliant and excluded from the deviation
The CORS default moves to :3000 with FRONTEND_ORIGIN retained as the override (task api-surface-trim)

The mock-OTP profile is loopback throughout: both dev servers bind 127.0.0.1, both Postgres ports publish to 127.0.0.1, and every URL uses the literal 127.0.0.1; LAN-reachable mock mode requires its own scoped security decision (task api-surface-trim)

POST /api/auth/refresh is in the allow-list with an observable criterion: refresh rotates the session cookies and a subsequent /api/auth/me succeeds, and the frontend retries once through refresh on an access-token 401

The warehouse E2E runs through an in-process integration harness exposing no runtime HTTP route, resolving WAREHOUSE and SelectionExecutor from the application module's DI container rather than hand-constructing them as the current test does

GET /health carries a narrow explicit exception for an infrastructure liveness probe sitting outside the versioned surface, and returns the constitution's standard response envelope with status: ok in its data
open_items: NON-BLOCKING (human decision, 2026-09-07): the requirements loop was stopped after round 4 rather than run to a clean round. Finding counts were 4/7/8/6 and were not converging; each round of added precision created new checkable edges, and about half of each round's findings were contradictions introduced by the previous round. Remaining items were refinements at an altitude below what a local PoC needs to start work.
NON-BLOCKING: a round-5 cold read was launched and cancelled; its findings were never read and are not reflected here.
NON-BLOCKING: the per-task grills (gate task) still run against each task plan before any code is written, so implementation-level defects have a further gate.

The spec text is byte-identical to what the four cold-read rounds actually interrogated (git confirms docs/specs/ unchanged since the grill); only requirements_digest's product-tree component moved, because committing changes it.

rounds.question: The vendored AppModule still registers chat, reports, saved queries, pins, measures, conversations and admin routes — but the trimmed migration deliberately removed tables several of them need. An authenticated user can reach endpoints that are misleading or that fail. The plan also promises a "health" surface, but no health controller exists. What do we do?
options: Leave as vendored, record a deferral

rounds.question: The repo-wide quality gate is scheduled as the last task (T7), so the frontend would be built before `verify.py` can enforce lint/format/typecheck. The `.envrc` currently declares no quality command at all.
options: Leave it at T7 as planned

rounds.question: "Append-only audit" is an acceptance criterion, but what's built is application-enforced inserts — there's no database trigger or permission model stopping a direct UPDATE or DELETE. How should the criterion read?

The vendored API doesn't meet several constitution requirements — typed response DTOs, complete Swagger error documentation, a /docs mount, structured logging, and global exception handling. The griller says "vendor as-is" isn't sufficient on its own.
options: Do the narrow compliance work now

rounds.question: The requirements grill isn't converging (4 → 7 → 8 → 6 findings across rounds), and about half of each round's findings are contradictions my own previous round introduced. How should I proceed?
